About COLOR ON Vision

Coloron Vision is an Apple-aesthetic professional AIoT video surveillance and optical security systems manufacturer and solutions provider. Delivering next-generation 4K ultra-low-light IP cameras, continuous 360° PTZ speed domes, enterprise RAID NVRs, radiometric thermal imaging, and biometric facial access terminals.

Compliance & Standards

  • NDAA Section 889 Compliant (100% free of high-risk chipset bans)
  • ONVIF Profile S, Profile G, Profile T certified
  • ISO 9001 Quality Management System certified
  • CE, FCC, RoHS, IP67 Weatherproof, IK10 Vandal-Resistance certified

Enterprise Warranty Terms

Cameras: 3-Year Commercial Manufacturer Warranty

Recorders: 5-Year Enterprise NVR & Storage Warranty

Service: 24/7 Firmware Hotfixes, Advance Hardware Replacement for Certified Partners

Breakthrough Optical & AI Technologies

ColorSense 24/7 Full Color

Combines super-large F1.0 apertures collecting 4x more ambient photons with 1/1.2-inch BSI CMOS sensors and deep-learning neural ISP processing, achieving vivid daytime color even down to 0.0003 Lux total darkness.

TurboVision Analog HD

Transmits uncompressed 5MP and 4K ultra-high-definition video, telemetry control, and coaxial audio over existing standard RG59/RG6 coaxial cable up to 500 meters without replacing legacy wiring.

AI Deep Learning NPU

On-chip 16 TOPS neural accelerator categorizes moving targets into humans and vehicles in real-time, eliminating up to 98% of nuisance false alarms caused by rain, swaying trees, and small animals.

Autonomous 3.0 PTZ Auto-Tracking

36x optical zoom pan-tilt-zoom domes automatically lock on and track vehicles and persons smoothly across 360° endless rotation at speeds up to 400° per second.

Bi-Spectrum Radiometric Thermography

Simultaneously pairs uncooled radiometric vanadium oxide thermal sensors (-20°C to 550°C) with 4K optical starlight sensors for early fire detection, overheat warning, and zero-visibility perimeter security.

Frequently Asked Technical & Support Questions

Q: How does Coloron ColorSense technology achieve full-color video in total darkness?

ColorSense combines a super-large F1.0 aperture lens (collecting 4x more ambient photons than standard F2.0 lenses) with a 1/1.2-inch ultra-sensitive sensor and our dedicated ISP neural processing chip. Even at 0.0003 Lux, it renders accurate daytime-quality color without grain or motion blur.

Q: Are Coloron cameras and NVRs compliant with NDAA and ONVIF?

Yes. All Coloron enterprise tier products are fully NDAA Section 889 compliant with zero high-risk telecommunications chipsets. They also strictly conform to ONVIF Profile S, G, and T, allowing interoperability with Milestone, Genetec, and third-party systems.

Q: Can I upgrade my existing analog coaxial CCTV to Coloron without rewiring?

Absolutely. Our TurboVision series transmits pristine 5MP and 4K video alongside audio and telemetry controls directly over standard RG59 or RG6 coaxial cable up to 500 meters, saving tremendous cabling labor.

Q: How does AI human and vehicle classification reduce false alarms?

Traditional PIR or pixel-motion sensors trigger alerts on blowing trees, heavy rain, spiders, or small animals. Coloron's on-chip deep neural network analyzes every moving frame in real-time, filtering out up to 98% of false alarms and notifying you only when human or vehicle contours enter your designated zones.

Q: What warranty and enterprise support does Coloron provide?

Coloron provides a 3-year standard manufacturer warranty on all commercial cameras, a 5-year warranty on enterprise NVRs, and advance hardware replacement service for certified enterprise partners.

Q: What video compression formats do Coloron cameras and recorders support?

Coloron devices support Smart H.265+, Ultra H.265, H.264+, H.264, and MJPEG. Coloron Smart H.265+ delivers up to 75% bandwidth and storage savings compared to standard H.264 without compromising image quality.

Q: Can Coloron IP cameras operate in extreme weather conditions?

Yes. Coloron exterior cameras feature rugged IP67 weatherproof and IK10 vandal-resistant cast aluminum housings. Built-in industrial defroster heaters and automated wipers enable continuous operation in temperatures from -40°C to +70°C (-40°F to 158°F).

Q: How do I access Coloron CCTV systems remotely?

Remote access is available via Coloron Connect mobile apps for iOS and Android, Coloron Guard Pro Client CMS for Windows and macOS (Apple Silicon native), and direct HTTPS web interfaces supporting modern Chromium browsers.
